#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    if (!(std::cin >> s)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("No input");
    }
    int ans = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && s[j] == s[i]) ++j;
        int len = j - i;
        if (len % 2 == 0) ++ans;
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
